network.coverage_note: The institution named in the task (Wyższa Szkoła Europejska im. ks. Józefa Tischnera) ceased to exist on 2024-10-01, having been converted into a branch of Uniwersytet SWPS (L54-55). The domain wse.krakow.pl is now an independent, unrelated business/marketing blog explicitly stating it is not a university, does not run recruitment or studies, and is not affiliated with Uniwersytet SWPS (L58). No Erasmus+/international contact, partner list, or campus information for the original institution is present in this evidence; the only contact available is the blog's general editorial email (L76) and editor-in-chief Wiesław Dąbrowski (L203-204), who are not connected to the former university's international office. No partner institutions or stated partner totals appear.
